propositions: docs/event-schema.md statically lists six LINK relations but omits caused_by, which is already supported in src/rebar/graph/_links.py:CANONICAL_RELATIONS (the seventh canonical relation).

The documented relation inventory is a manually duplicated list that drifted from the authoritative source after caused_by was added in commit 901241b218 but docs/event-schema.md was not updated; commit 693a6bf412 later rewrote the LINK row and retained the stale six-value inventory.

The maintained event-schema.md does not document caused_by as directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing, contrary to the design authority (isogonal-wedged-catfish) which explicitly required these semantics to appear.
A documentation contract test must enforce set equality between the parsed event-schema LINK relation inventory and src/rebar/graph/_links.py:CANONICAL_RELATIONS to prevent future relation omissions.
